name: Hong Kong
dataProvenance: Wills Ordinance (Cap. 30), Intestates' Estates Ordinance (Cap. 73), Probate and Administration Ordinance (Cap. 10), Non-Contentious Probate Rules (Cap. 10A), Mandatory Provident Fund Schemes Ordinance (Cap. 485)
description: Hong Kong succession rules: grant types under Cap. 10, MPF death benefit nominations under Cap. 485, cross-border PRC asset considerations, intestacy distribution under Cap. 73, and small estate grants.

conformanceRules.description: Local grant type should be specified for Hong Kong estates entering probate

keyFeatures: Intestacy ordinance, no estate duty (abolished 2006), MPF death benefit nomination, intestacyHierarchy (Cap. 73), newTerritoriesCustomaryLaw (tso/tong Cap. 97), preReformCustomaryLaw (pre-1971 MRO)
